description: ATES Avalanche Terrain Exposure Scale Recreation Boundaries is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Boundaries that represent a recreation area for snowmobiling or backcountry skiing that has had the Avalanche Terrain Exposure Scale (ATES) completed. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are ATES, avalanche, recreation. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2023-06-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
